read-update-pdf-metadata.title: Read and Update PDF Metadata
read-update-pdf-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, read its existing metadata, modify fields such as title and author, and save the updated information to a new file using Aspose.Pdf.

read-pdf-author-metadata.title: Read PDF Author Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and retrieve the Author metadata property, outputting it to the console.

read-pdf-title-metadata-log.title: Read PDF Title Metadata and Write to Log
read-pdf-title-metadata-log.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read the Title metadata from a PDF file and write the result to a log file.

retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Retrieve PDF Keywords Metadata using PdfFileInfo
retrieve-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and read the Keywords metadata property, then display it on the console.

read-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Read PDF Creator Metadata
read-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to retrieve the Creator metadata property from an existing PDF file.

read-pdf-modification-date.title: Read PDF Modification Date with PdfFileInfo
read-pdf-modification-date.description: Shows how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to obtain the ModDate metadata from a PDF and output it in a friendly format.

update-pdf-author-metadata.title: Update PDF Author Metadata with PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-author-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Author property of a PDF file using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo class and persist the changes to a new file with SaveNewInfo.

update-pdf-title-metadata.title: Update PDF Title Metadata using PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-title-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Title property of a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the changes to a new document.

set-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Set PDF Keywords Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign a Keywords metadata value to a PDF file with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, save the updated document, and verify the change.

set-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Set PDF Creator Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to assign a custom Creator value to a PDF file by using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and persisting the change with SaveNewInfo.

add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata to PDF using PdfFileInfo
add-custom-metadata-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a custom metadata entry (ProjectCode) to an existing PDF and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ProjectCode)
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata.description: Shows how to read a custom metadata entry named "ProjectCode" from a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata 'ReviewedBy' to PDF
add-custom-metadata-reviewedby-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to set a custom metadata field in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and persist the changes to a new file.

retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.title: Retrieve Custom PDF Metadata (ReviewedBy)
retrieve-custom-pdf-metadata-reviewedby.description: Demonstrates how to use Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to read a custom metadata property from a PDF document and log its value.

add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.title: Add Custom Department Metadata to PDFs
add-department-metadata-to-pdfs.description: Demonstrates how to loop through PDF files, set a custom "Department" metadata field using PdfFileInfo, and save the updated PDFs to a new folder.

add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.title: Add Custom Metadata Field to PDF Using PdfFileInfo
add-custom-metadata-field-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to preserve existing custom metadata in a PDF and add a new "Version" field using the PdfFileInfo facade, then save the updated document.

remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.title: Remove Custom PDF Metadata Entry
remove-custom-pdf-metadata-entry.description: Demonstrates how to delete a specific custom metadata field from a PDF by setting its value to an empty string using the PdfFileInfo facade.

read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.title: Read Custom PDF Metadata with Existence Check
read-custom-pdf-metadata-existence-check.description: Shows how to verify a PDF file exists and safely read a custom metadata key "Confidential" using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.title: Add LastUpdated Metadata to PDF
add-lastupdated-metadata-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a custom metadata field named "LastUpdated" with the current UTC timestamp to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the updated document.

update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.title: Update PDF Metadata and Save to New File
update-pdf-metadata-save-new-file.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF metadata such as title, author, subject, keywords, creator, and modification date using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo and save the updated information to a new PDF file.

load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.title: Load PDF, Retrieve File Info, and Save with Proper Disposal
load-pdf-retrieve-file-info-and-save.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Document inside a using block, accessing file‑level information with PdfFileInfo, and saving the document while ensuring both objects are correctly disposed.

backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.title: Backup PDFs and Update Metadata with PdfFileInfo
backup-and-update-pdf-metadata.description: The example creates a backup of each PDF in a folder, then uses Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo to modify common metadata fields and saves the changes to the original file.

audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.title: Audit PDF Metadata Changes and Log to CSV
audit-pdf-metadata-to-csv.description: Demonstrates how to read existing PDF metadata with Aspose.Pdf.Facades, modify selected fields, save the updated PDF, and record original and new values to a CSV file for auditing.

handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.title: Handle Read‑Only File Errors When Saving PDF Metadata
handle-readonly-file-errors-when-saving-.description: Demonstrates how to modify PDF metadata with Aspose.Pdf.Facades and reliably save it even when the target file is marked as read‑only by clearing the attribute and retrying.

update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.title: Update PDF Metadata Using MemoryStream and PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-metadata-memorystream.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF into a MemoryStream, modifying its metadata with PdfFileInfo, and saving the updated document to a new file.

update-pdf-keywords-metadata.title: Update PDF Keywords Metadata Using PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-keywords-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF from a stream with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, modify the Keywords metadata, and save the updated document to a new file.

update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.title: Update PDF Author Metadata Conditionally
update-pdf-author-metadata-conditional.description: Shows how to read a PDF's Author metadata with PdfFileInfo, set it only when the field is empty, and save the updated document.

list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.title: List Custom PDF Metadata Keys Alphabetically
list-custom-pdf-metadata-keys.description: Shows how to extract all custom metadata keys from a PDF, sort them alphabetically, and output each key with its value using Aspose.Pdf.

merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.title: Merge XMP Metadata with PDF FileInfo
merge-xmp-metadata-with-pdf-fileinfo.description: Demonstrates how to combine standard PDF FileInfo metadata with custom XMP metadata in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

read-pdf-version.title: Read PDF Version Using Aspose.Pdf Facade
read-pdf-version.description: Shows how to bind a PDF file with PdfFileInfo and retrieve its version string for later use.

export-pdf-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-metadata-to-json.description: The program scans a folder for PDF files, extracts their metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, and writes the collected information to a JSON file for external processing.

import-json-metadata-to-pdf.title: Import JSON Metadata and Apply to PDF Files
import-json-metadata-to-pdf.description: The example reads a JSON file containing metadata definitions and applies the standard and custom properties to corresponding PDF documents using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo.

apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.title: Apply Metadata Changes to Multiple PDFs in Parallel
apply-metadata-changes-to-multiple-pdfs-.description: Demonstrates how to update the Title, Author, and Subject metadata of several PDF files concurrently using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and the Task Parallel Library.

thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.title: Thread‑Safe Parallel PDF Metadata Update with PdfFileInfo
thread-safe-parallel-pdf-metadata-update.description: Demonstrates processing multiple PDF files concurrently and safely updating their metadata using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo with per‑file locking.

validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.title: Validate and Set PDF Metadata with Regex using PdfFileInfo
validate-set-pdf-metadata-with-regex.description: The example loads a PDF with Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo, validates each metadata value against a regular expression, sets standard and custom properties, and saves the updated file.

read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.title: Read PDF Metadata with Null Handling
read-pdf-metadata-with-null-handling.description: Shows how to read custom and standard PDF metadata using PdfFileInfo and gracefully handle null or empty values.

update-pdf-subject-metadata.title: Update PDF Subject Metadata with PdfFileInfo
update-pdf-subject-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to modify the Subject field of a PDF's metadata using the Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfFileInfo class and save the changes to a new file.

set-pdf-language-property.title: Set PDF Language Property Using PdfFileInfo
set-pdf-language-property.description: Demonstrates how to set the PDF language metadata to "en-US" using the PdfFileInfo facade and save the updated document.

convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-using-pdffileinfo.title: Convert PDF to PDF/A-1B Using PdfFileInfo
convert-pdf-to-pdfa-1b-using-pdffileinfo.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfFileInfo, convert it to PDF/A‑1B compliance, and save the archival‑ready file.

set-pdf-document-id-using-guid.title: Set PDF Document ID Using GUID Metadata
set-pdf-document-id-using-guid.description: Generates a new GUID and stores it as a custom metadata entry (DocumentID) in a PDF using the PdfFileInfo facade. The updated PDF is saved with the new identifier.
